_source: Static UI keys for the mobile service-technician job list (route tech-jobs, pototype/mobile-screens.jsx MTechJobs L198-257). KEYS ONLY — never a translation. MIXED LAYERS: fields listed as dict below are stable ids read with t(); the rest are the Thai phrase that IS the phrases-layer key, read with tp(). NEAR-TOTAL ZERO-MINT — the merged WEB after-sales port renders the same register, so its dict already holds this screen's words: statToday=sales.common.today 'วันนี้' (L214), statUrgent=sales.service.prioHigh 'ด่วน' (L215), btnStart=sales.service.btnStartFix 'เริ่มซ่อม' (L243, byte-identical to the prototype button AND to the web port's own label for the same `start` op), the 5 pill labels = sales.service.status* ('รับเรื่อง' L239 / 'นัดช่าง' / 'กำลังซ่อม' L237 / 'ซ่อมเสร็จ' / 'ปิดงาน'), failed=admin.common.actionFailedToast (the pm_checkin / pm_checklist / pm_notes precedent for an honest rejected write). btnSchedule reuses sales.service.statusScheduled 'นัดช่าง' — the button is labelled with the status the move lands on, the same convention the merged web port uses when it labels the `fix` op with sales.service.statusFixed. TWO values are net-new and staged in agents/orch-d-recon/service-group-i18n.apply.json for a Wei sacred round (docs/extract/i18n-full.json is UNTOUCHED by this slice): title 'งานของฉัน' (L207) and btnClose 'ปิดงานซ่อม' (L266 — the tech-close screen's own title, which this card's button opens; minted once and shared by both sidecars). Both already resolve in Thai today (tp returns the key for lang th) and light up en/zh/ar once applied. See BLOCKERS.md B-292. NOT REPRESENTED HERE — four prototype strings are DROPPED rather than keyed, because each is a PROMISE and a promise cannot be em-dashed the way a missing value can: (1) 'เลื่อนนัด' (L244) — there is NO reschedule op on the route at all; (2) 'ซ่อมเสร็จ + ปิดงาน' (L247) — no single op moves `fixing` to `closed`; the machine's move from `fixing` is `fix`, and the close is a separate move from `fixed` (apps/api/src/routes/sales-service.ts L21-27); (3) 'นัดลูกค้า' (L249) — the `schedule` op notifies nobody; there is no customer notification anywhere in this route; (4) 'เรตติ้ง' (L216) — the third stat tile is omitted entirely because service_ticket has NO rating column and the close handler's own comment says that round did not invent one (sales-service.ts L354-356), so there is neither a label nor a value. ALSO NOT MINTED: the prototype's scheduled PILL reads 'นัดแล้ว' (L238) while its own srv-track timeline calls the same state 'นัดช่าง' (L142) — the prototype is internally inconsistent about one status, so this port renders the existing dict key on both screens instead of minting a synonym that would fragment the vocabulary. Filed in BLOCKERS.md B-292 for a ruling. The mock technician trade in the eyebrow ('ช่างวิชัย · ประปา', L207) is not a key either: the name half is the REAL user.name from GET /me, and `user` has no trade column, so that half is dropped.
_layers: dict (t): statToday · statUrgent · btnSchedule · btnStart · statusReceived · statusScheduled · statusFixing · statusFixed · statusClosed · failed. phrases (tp): title · btnClose.
